title: Idempotence of counter patching
statement: Let $ct$ be an integer-indexed tape of optional symbols, let $cp$ be an integer, and let $u$ and $v$ be words over an alphabet. If $u$ and $v$ have equal lengths, then patching $ct$ with $u$ at $cp$ and then patching the result with $v$ at the same position gives the same tape as patching $ct$ directly with $v$ at $cp$.
hypotheses_covered: $ct$ is an integer-indexed tape of optional symbols
$u$ and $v$ are words over an alphabet
